P RACTICAL PROJECT · PART 1
Product Search UI

Combine DOM selection, input events, debounce, AbortController, fetch, JSON parsing, safe rendering and
accessible status messages.
Search කරන විට typing නවතින තුරැ request එක පරක්කු කරන්න. පරණ request එක cancel කරලා latest result එක විතරක් Jපන්වන්න. Status message එJකන් loading සහ error states user ට දැනුම් Jදන්න.
Input event Debounce 250 ms Fetch with signal Check status · JSON array Latest ID check textContent + list Accessible status

Serve the page and API on the same origin. GET /api/products?q=tea should return a JSON array, e.g.
[{"name":"Tea"}]. If there are no results, return []. This project assumes such an endpoint exists; it does not
include server code.

Typing quickly triggers one request after a quiet period. Old results are ignored. Success, empty and failure
states are shown using the status region. Product names are inserted as plain text.
